description:
Saves the log and GoAccess settings; send only what changes. Fields set by environment variables are ignored. tls_handshake_log can only be turned on while write_log_files is on, otherwise the answer is 400. Log file settings reload nginx; the GoAccess settings are stored and apply after a container restart. The change is applied before it is saved: when applying fails, nothing is saved.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

requestBody.description: The settings to change; fields you leave out keep their value

write_log_files.description: Write the error and stream log files; forced on by GOA (env LOGROTATE)

log_format.description: Format of the access and stream log files: classic or json (env NGINX_LOG_FORMAT)

tls_handshake_log.description: Write failed and rejected TLS handshakes of the default site and the admin UI to /data/nginx/logs/tls.log at level info, while the log files are on (env NGINX_TLS_HANDSHAKE_LOG)

goaccess.description: GoAccess report (env GOA); applies after a container restart

goaccess_keep_days.description: GoAccess keeps report data for this many days (--keep-last). Applies after a container restart

goaccess_anonymize.description: Anonymize visitor IPs in the GoAccess report: off or the --anonymize-level. Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_drop_query_strings.description: Drop query strings from the URLs in the GoAccess report (--no-query-string). Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_real_os.description: Full operating system versions in the GoAccess report (--real-os). Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_resolve_hosts.description: Resolve visitor host names in the GoAccess report (--with-output-resolver). Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

200.description: The log files and GoAccess settings after the save, in the same form as the GET answer
